hook: Four gold ingots were hidden inside a toilet tank during a raid in Caleta Olivia.

text_overlay.text: Gold Hidden in a Toilet Tank

sections.voiceover: Prefectura Naval Argentina searched the property on October 9, 2026. Investigators sought clues after a man vanished on December 7, 2025. Where did the 4 gold ingots come from?
b_roll: Officers inspecting documents in Santa Cruz
Evidence bags on a steel table

sections.voiceover: Weighing over 2.5 kilos, the metal turned up after Prefectura Naval Argentina raided Caleta Olivia.
Officers seized the hidden treasure during two targeted operations in Santa Cruz. Prefectura Naval Argentina also seized an automobile, a DVR recording system, and two cell phones.
b_roll: Prefectura officers opening a secure vault
Forensic specialists dusting a seized car door for fingerprints

sections.voiceover: Prefectura Naval Argentina continues investigating the Santa Cruz disappearance.
